description: This source file defines a global application class for an ASP.NET Web Forms application, containing startup logic that loads embedding configuration from a JSON file during application initialization.

classes.name: Global
classes.description: Application class that handles global events for ASP.NET Web Forms, specifically application startup to initialize embed configuration.

methods.name: Application_Start
methods.description: Handles the application start event, reads embed configuration from a JSON file, and registers routes. If reading fails, maps a route for error logging.
